keywords: Role of engineer 2.Attitude as society worker 3.Heart of Autonomy, independence
educationalGoal: Students think about the role of engineers, understand the attitude as society workers and response ability to real society. Aim to create a personality control themselves. Through the basic lecture and group discussion, learn the role, responsibility of engineers, also advance communication ability. Through the mock interview and creating a resume, students learn the importance of pre-planning, positive act. Finally have self-reliance and courage to positively think their future.
advice: This seminar is mainly consist of life-related events, basic lecture and group discussion, mock interview and creating a resume, personal statement. (Summary of lectures) 1 Life-related events: Students aware rules, roles, responsibilities. To listen to the speech, sing the national anthem at the morning & evening color of the gathering, students deeply aware as Japanese. 2 Basic lecture: Listen to the lecture provided by the professor of their major, students learn the attitude about engineers, society workers, prepare for their future. 3 Group discussion: Select one within three “engineer, society worker” related themes which shown in basic lecture. each group do a brain-storming, make a story and present a speech. 4 Mock interview: To experience group and individual mock interview, students realize the necessity for prepare the job hunting with their self-reliance and courage. 5 Resume, personal statement: Students experience to create resume and personal statement. According to the format. (Advice for the seminar) 1 Have a medical check before departure. If you are poor condition at departure, report it to the instructor. 2 Recommend to read the files in the syllabus of “humanity and nature seminar 3” prior to the seminar. 3 In this seminar, to share each other abilities, support each other, positive attitude are essence.
